chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Abū Ayyūb, from Abū ʿUbaydah, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

Indeed, ʿAlī عليه السلام was brought a woman with a man who had committed fornication with her. She said, “He forced me, by Allah, O Amīr al-Muʾminīn.” So he waived the hadd punishment from her. If these people were asked about that, they would say, “She is not to be believed,” yet by Allah Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام did this.

key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام as Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.اسْتَكْرَهَنِي: he compelled me against my will
key_terms.فَجَرَ بِهَا: committed illicit sexual intercourse with her

ai.seo_question: What did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام rule when a woman accused of zina said she was forced?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal judgment of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام in a case where a woman claimed coercion in zina. He removed the hadd punishment from her, showing that compulsion negates liability in such a case and highlighting the judicial fairness of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام.
